description: This Java class 'StatusWorker' provides static methods to query and retrieve status-related data from the database, such as status items and valid change details, and sets them as attributes in a JSP PageContext.

classes.name: StatusWorker
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to fetch status items and change details, used within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of status items for a given status type ID and sets it as a page context attribute.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Retrieves status items for two status type IDs, combines them, and sets as a page context attribute.

methods.name: getStatusValidChangeToDetails
methods.description: Retrieves valid status change details for a given status ID and sets it as a page context attribute.
